projectDescription: A full-stack platform that ingests Discord community messages, runs them through an AI-powered LangGraph pipeline to classify sentiment and topics, and generates ready-to-publish content assets (LinkedIn posts, FAQs, community highlights) with a curation workflow and dashboard.
keyFeatures: JSON/CSV batch ingestion with validation, normalization, and deduplication
LangGraph-based multi-node processing pipeline with four routing paths (achievement, recurring question, blocker, period summary)
AI classification and relevance scoring via Gemini or OpenRouter
Automated generation of LinkedIn posts, FAQ/tips, and community highlights
Asset curation workflow with state machine (generated → reviewed → approved/rejected)
Async worker with PostgreSQL-backed job queue and at-least-once delivery
Real-time dashboard with KPI metrics (messages, sentiment distribution, assets, alerts)
Full Docker Compose stack: proxy (nginx), web (Next.js), api (FastAPI), worker, PostgreSQL
OCI Object Storage integration for persisting generated asset packages
Source traceability: every generated asset links back to original messages
publicApiSurface: GET /api/mensajes (paginated message list with canal filter)
GET /api/curaduria/activos (paginated asset list with estado/formato filters)
preparar_entrada(interacciones, *, origen_comunidad, periodo_referencia, cierre_periodo) — pipeline adapter
